summary: Enhance your skills with our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Training Course. Learn to streamline operations and boost productivity effectively.
lede: Business Central training covers how finance, operations, and ERP support professionals configure records and process routine transactions. Participants practice maintaining customer, vendor, item, and general ledger data; setting posting groups and dimensions; processing sales, purchase, and inventory transactions; reconciling ledger entries; and reporting with account schedules and Power BI. It also covers approval workflows, a basic Power Automate flow, sandbox testing, and control documentation, while advanced manufacturing, service management, and extension development are introduced conceptually.
audienceIntro: This Business Central course is designed for professionals who configure records, process transactions, control financial data, support users, or oversee ERP-enabled operations.
modules: Business Central Role Centers and Navigation
Business Central Workflows and Power Automate
Business Central Reporting and Adoption Roadmap
prerequisites: You need a laptop with a current web browser and reliable internet access. Training uses a browser-based Business Central environment, supplied practice records, and guided Power BI and Power Automate activities. Advanced manufacturing, service management, Dataverse architecture, extension development, and Copilot governance receive conceptual awareness only. Core finance, sales, purchasing, inventory, reporting, and workflow tasks receive hands-on operational application.
